title: Human Resources Management in the Hospitality Industry

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, role, and importance of human resources management in the hospitality industry.
Explain the strategic role of HR departments and the division of HR responsibilities among different levels of management.
Analyze the impact of internal and external factors on HR management in the hospitality industry.
Describe and explain the various HR activities and practices in the hospitality industry.
Identify and solve problems related to HR activities in the hospitality industry.
Evaluate HR activities and apply knowledge to propose solutions for HR issues.
Communicate effectively about HR activities and related issues.
Build and organize teams to complete group assignments and discuss HR issues.
Demonstrate and develop critical thinking skills in evaluating HR issues.
Express and develop problem-solving and critical thinking skills in evaluating HR issues.
